entries.head: c8f7bd582ffc1301b851dde2364c60f1636aac8b
entries.reason: Common runner readable/implementation/source/run_guarded_v3.py.txt calls process.wait() at line 368 before unconditional final killpg(process.pid) at line 371. A reused numeric group can be signalled after reap. #6866 documents the defect and #6867 proposes correction; original snapshot needs revision or substantive exact-successor reconciliation.

Process-group preservation, the complete source/native binding scope, genuine baseline/comparison and successful CLOSE adoption, actual qualification/resource fit and full equality remain open. This delivery awards no original-activity or performance credit and starts no new execution or research round.

Follow-up source audit: [PR #6866](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6866), at `fcba647106f3e2f08de1b39ebed04a13c0a6ef8b`, identifies a concrete limitation in this PR's common runner. It can reap its child before an unconditional final numeric group signal; a reused number can then identify an unrelated group. The Linux v6.12 source check explains why held pidfds do not prevent that numeric lookup race.

This preserves the factory/cwd corrections established here and the earlier timer/error correction. The audit's proposed signal-before-consuming-wait owner, its exact caller/source-binding successor and discriminating controls are not implemented or executed. Complete source/runtime qualification and the original comparison remain open. The [maintained goal and contributor handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321#issuecomment-6713710045) records the next connected revision.

entries.head: 3652e9191530fb02e2e5efe92b2b53386890874d
entries.reason: Author correction identifies compiler carrier width 153, not target rank 145. Committed capacity/minimum-power calculation still uses target rank. Correct the source proof/checks and recompute exact or interval bounds; author reports minimum power 2086. The stated 2100 may still suffice, but the committed derivation must use the correct width.

comments.body: Correction: the compiler capacity line here used m = 145, the largest target rank. The literal carrier is 153 (9 base rows + 8 per stage x 18; the 8 complement rows are in no target), and the fit is m c <= N. So the minimum logarithm power is 2086, not 2064. The written 2100 still passes. κ and invoice unchanged.
